endpoint.description: Base URL of the provider API (https; http only with -class-allow-http)

tokenVariable.description: Path of the Variable whose item token is the bearer token of the calls

ports.description: Frontend ports the provider supports, e.g. 80,443,8000-8100; empty means any

parameters.description: Provider specific settings, sent with every call

lastHeartbeat.description: RFC 3339 time of the last heartbeat
